statement: Every fallback site the detector module reports (two-source reads, typeof dual paths, catch-and-default) has a census record in data/fallback-census/census.json: the site's file, range and content hash, the class derived from V8 block coverage collected with NODE_V8_COVERAGE over the unit, packaging, integration and bootstrap corpus and one fresh-formation scenario (never, primary-only, fallback-only, both, or unloaded when no run loaded the file), and the identity of every run that contributed; the census is produced by one script under scripts/checks that merges the per-process coverage files and joins them to the detector sites, so that the budget row fallback_sites_uncensused reads zero at the head the census was taken on.

constraints.statement: Instrumentation is environment-based (NODE_V8_COVERAGE through the existing runners and the harness's NODE_OPTIONS composition). No file under src/ changes for the census.
A site in a file no run loaded is recorded as unloaded and stays uncensused for the retirement rows. An incomplete lane fails its sites; it never acquits them.
A record binds to the site's content hash. A site whose hash no longer matches is uncensused again; nothing is inferred from a line number or a filename.

Each record lists the runs (lane, host, commit, timestamp, coverage directory digest) whose coverage it joined, so a consumer can ask whether a side executed under a formation and not only under unit tests.
The corpus and the formation run go to the lab through node scripts/lab.js; the controller runs only the merge and the join.
